headline: Five stocks offering higher dividend yields than bank deposits
hook: Equities outperforming fixed deposit interest rates

modes.bear: High dividend yields can sometimes signal a falling stock price or a company paying out capital it should be reinvesting for growth.
modes.bull: High dividend yields provide a steady cash flow that beats inflation and bank interest, making these stocks attractive for income-focused portfolios.
modes.simple: Some companies pay out a portion of their profits to shareholders as dividends. These five companies are currently paying out more cash to shareholders than a bank would pay in interest on a fixed deposit.

summary: CyberTech Systems, Majestic Auto, Jagran Prakashan, IL&FS Investment Managers, and Premco Global are currently offering dividend yields reaching up to 19.6%. This return significantly exceeds the 8% to 8.6% interest rates typically provided by standard fixed deposits. Retail investors often look to high-dividend stocks as an alternative income stream to traditional savings instruments. These figures highlight specific equities that have outperformed bank deposit benchmarks in recent yield assessments.
why_it_matters: Higher potential income than bank deposits for dividend-focused portfolios.
winners_losers: Dividend-seeking investors gain / FD-only savers lag

headline: Five smallcap stocks under ₹100 offering high dividend yields
hook: High-yield opportunities in the smallcap space

modes.bear: High yields in smallcaps may be a trap if the company is struggling or if the dividend payout is not sustainable long-term.
modes.bull: High dividend yields provide a steady cash flow stream and can act as a buffer during market volatility for smallcap portfolios.
modes.simple: Some smaller, cheaper stocks pay out a good portion of their profits as dividends. While this can be a nice bonus, always check if the company is healthy before buying just for the dividend.

summary: A list of five smallcap companies trading below ₹100 per share has been identified for their high dividend yields. The list includes Jagran Prakashan and Radiant Cash Management Services among others. These stocks are highlighted for investors seeking income-generating assets within the smallcap segment. Retail investors should note that high dividend yields can sometimes indicate falling stock prices or unsustainable payout ratios.
why_it_matters: Potential for passive income, but check payout sustainability before investing.

headline: Five small-cap stocks under ₹100 offer high dividend yields for FY26

modes.bear: High yields in small-caps can sometimes signal cyclical peaks, low liquidity, or limited future capital appreciation.
modes.bull: High dividend yields above 15% on stocks under ₹100 provide strong passive income potential for retail portfolios.
modes.simple: Some smaller companies trading under ₹100 are paying out large portions of their earnings as dividends, offering good cash returns for investors.

summary: Jagran Prakashan and IL&FS Investment Managers lead a group of small-cap stocks trading below ₹100 that offer attractive dividend yields for FY26. Jagran leads with a 16.1% yield, followed by IL&FS at 15.9% and Radiant Cash Management at 7.9%. Gateway Distriparks and Balmer Lawrie Investments round out the group with yields of 7.6% and 6.8% respectively. For retail investors, these low-priced stocks present income generation opportunities in the small-cap segment.
why_it_matters: Low-priced small-caps offer high dividend payouts for income investors.
winners_losers: Dividend seekers gain / growth investors neutral

headline: 10 lesser-known Indian stocks offer dividend yields up to 19% in FY26
hook: High-yield dividend picks beyond the bluechips

modes.bear: Extraordinarily high dividend yields in small-cap stocks can sometimes accompany low liquidity and weak underlying growth.
modes.bull: High yields offer attractive cash returns for income-focused portfolios beyond standard large-cap dividend payers.
modes.simple: Some smaller companies pay out a large share of profits as dividends, offering extra cash for shareholders, but they carry higher stock price risks.

summary: LiveMint has highlighted ten lesser-known Indian listed companies offering substantial dividend yields for FY26. CyberTech Systems leads the list with a yield of 19.6%, followed by Majestic Auto at 16.4% and Jagran Prakashan at 16.1%. Other notable names include IL&FS Investment Managers at 15.9% and Premco Global at 11.2%. For Indian retail investors, high dividend yields can provide steady income, though low liquidity in smaller-cap stocks warrants careful consideration.
why_it_matters: Higher income potential from lesser-known small-cap stock holdings.
winners_losers: Dividend-seeking investors gain / liquidity-constrained traders cautious
